cmark.method: Fresh processes in alternating/reversed order. Ordinary unmodified archive controls and diagnostic-only blocks.c object with two guarded generated phase hooks. Per-inline-container clocks perturb diagnostic timing; inline sums exclude traversal, inline_walk includes it. Feed includes block extension hooks; footnotes are timed directly; finish residual includes block finalization and cleanup. Autolink postprocess is timed directly; removing extensions is a diagnostic ablation, not a product proposal. Source generation, tree/HTML fingerprints and release excluded from parse timing. Same-mode fingerprints checked; different extension modes can change semantics.
